CHF.note: *** A HEADWIND ON THREE OF OUR FOUR PAIRS, AND IT IS WORTH READING IN FULL. investingLive, 22 Oct: EUR/CHF has fallen to about 0.9220, a THREE-MONTH LOW, breaking trendline support, the 0.9300 level and the 100-day average, now testing the 200-day near 0.9235. The driver is named plainly: "the Swiss franc draws renewed support from its traditional safe-haven appeal". The cause is FRENCH: 10-year French yields above 5%, the highest since 2002, and the France-Germany spread near 170bp, the WIDEST SINCE 2011. The author adds that "the SNB had only recently toned down its language on foreign exchange intervention" and wonders whether policymakers must reconsider. *** THIS IS A STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT FOR A STRONGER CHF, and three of four pairs are SHORT CHF. Our board has CHF weakest at -1.20 on the fundamentals; the market is bidding it as a haven. Those are different questions and the daily should not pretend otherwise.
